done_when: scripts/fast-test.py selects only: test files that changed, test files whose file name contains a changed module's name, and test files that mention forge/<module>.py or forge.<module>; it still runs the full command when conftest.py, pyproject.toml or uv.lock change; CI keeps running the full suite. A change to src/forge/review.py selects fewer than a third of the test files. One command-level test shows the selection for a change to review.py. New and existing repos: Forge's own script only; client repos are unchanged.
why: Forge's fast test command selects any test file whose text contains a changed module's name, so a change to review.py or close.py still runs about 95% of the suite and closes take 20-40 minutes
